title: Task page: detail, project/subtasks, threaded comments and mentions

nextAction: Product Development Lead should preserve and integrate the final TaskPage cleanup as a coherent commit, then confirm it is included in the intended release; attach or identify a canonical Task if follow-up tracking is needed.
